answer: Proof of Burn provides robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to destroy native tokens to gain network weight, analogous to a comet shedding mass as it nears a solar ridge. By tethering influence to tangible financial sacrifice, the system forces attackers to liquidate assets, effectively turning the network into a barren orchard for those lacking significant capital. The cost to an attacker scales linearly with the desired influence, rendering large-scale identity replication economically irrational.
